speed.notes: 40 feet, fly 140 feet; magma swim 40 feet;

traits.name: Wing Deflection
traits.text: ⬲ Trigger The dragon is targeted with an attack Effect The dragon raises a wing, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the dragon is Flying, they descend 10 feet after the attack.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬺ (evocation, fire, primal); The dragon breathes a blast of magma that deals 9d6 (9d6) fire damage and 4d12 (4d12) bludgeoning damage in a 40-foot cone (DC 33 basic Reflex save). They can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Draconic Frenzy
traits.text: ⬺ The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one horn Strike in any order.

traits.name: Draconic Momentum
traits.text: The dragon recharges their Breath Weapon whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

traits.name: Magma Swim
traits.text: A magma dragon's swim Speed functions only when the dragon is Swimming through magma or molten lava.

traits.name: Volcanic Purge
traits.text: ⬻ If the next action the dragon uses is Breath Weapon, the magma clings to those it damages. Each creature that fails its save against the Breath Weapon takes 4d6 (4d6) persistent fire damage, and as long as it has this persistent fire damage, it also takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speeds.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +27 (fire, magical, reach 15 feet); Damage 3d10+12 (3d10+12) piercing plus 3d6 (3d6) fire

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +27 (agile, magical, reach 10 feet); Damage 3d10+12 (3d10+12) slashing
